passage.label: Whatever heavens earth exalts Allah Exalted Might Wise; O believed why say what not do; great hatred sight Allah say what not do; indeed Allah loves those fight His cause row as though single structure joined firmly

arabicExcerpts.text: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
كَبُرَ مَقۡتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُواْ مَا لَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفّٗا كَأَنَّهُم بُنۡيَٰنٞ مَّرۡصُوصٞ

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the firm-rank imagery (4) before the Musa narrative opens (5); P2 ends with the religion-of-truth prevalence declaration (9) before the saving-trade offer begins (10); P3 runs from that offer through the victory promise, the hawariyyun dialogue and the closing dominance statement (10-14).
